twitter_thread: Migration fear is the main thing keeping QA teams on tools they've outgrown. Here's what the actual TestRail → TestFiesta migration looks like. 🧵
Step 1: Get your TestRail API key (My Settings → API Keys → Add Key). 2 minutes.
Step 2: In TestFiesta, go to Settings → Import → Import from TestRail. Enter your TestRail URL, email, and API key. Select projects. Click Start Import.
What transfers: test cases, suites, sections, runs, results, attachments. All of it. No CSV exports, no manual data entry.
For a typical team (500-3,000 test cases): import completes in under 10 minutes. Full migration including setup: 2-4 hours. Full guide: testfiesta.com/blog/migrate-from-testrail
